question: Could you review our records in June 2022 and identify which countries have the longest streak of consecutive inserted city dates? Please list the 2-letter length country codes of these countries.
sql:
WITH june_cities AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT country_code_2, CAST(insert_date AS DATE) AS ins_date
    FROM cities
    WHERE insert_date LIKE '2022-06-%'
),
numbered AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, ins_date,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY country_code_2 ORDER BY ins_date) AS rn
    FROM june_cities
),
groups AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, ins_date,
           ins_date - INTERVAL (rn) DAY AS grp
    FROM numbered
),
streaks AS (
    SELECT country_code_2, grp,
           COUNT(*) AS streak_len,
           MIN(ins_date) AS start_date,
           MAX(ins_date) AS end_date
    FROM groups
    GROUP BY country_code_2, grp
),
max_streak AS (
    SELECT MAX(streak_len) AS max_len
    FROM streaks
)
SELECT s.country_code_2
FROM streaks s
CROSS JOIN max_streak m
WHERE s.streak_len = m.max_len
ORDER BY s.country_code_2
